name: Short Cut BBQ Mini Turkey Meatloaves with Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place stuffing mix (making sure you get a good combination of bread and seasoning), water, barbecue sauce, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl, then stir to combine. Add turkey and mix with your hands until the meatloaf mixture is well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup stuffing mix
barbecue sauce
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper
340 g ground turkey

instructions.primary_message: Divide meatloaf mixture between 6 muffin cups. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until almost cooked through, about 15 minutes.

When the meatloaves are almost cooked through, remove from the oven, and top with additional barbecue sauce and cheese. Return to the oven and continue to bake until cooked through and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
barbecue sauce
⅔ cup cheddar cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place broccoli bag on a microwave-safe plate and pierce with a fork. Place in the microwave and cook on high, until tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove plate from microwave and carefully open the bag. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (340 g) bag broccoli florets
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide meatloaves and broccoli between plates. Enjoy!
